changes.summary: An NGO project page for a government high school in Chintamani reports only some rooms in poor condition and a rebuilt block opened in 2025. No news report on district classroom repair was reachable.

findings.claim: A government high school in Chintamani, Chikkaballapura district, had 15 rooms in two buildings with some in poor condition; a new building was inaugurated in 2025.
findings.quote: The school has 15 rooms in 2 buildings, few rooms are not in good condition.
findings.title: New Government High School, Chintamani, Karnataka

changes.summary: Only indirect, aggregator-level figures were found: a youth-data profile shows 34.1% of girls aged 15 to 21 out of education, and 2011 Census figures show female literacy well below male literacy.

findings.claim: Census-based figures cited for Chikballapur district put female literacy at 61.55%, compared with 77.75% for males.

changes.summary: A 2023 news report and two NGO project pages show Kolar government schools with few usable rooms: roof flaking at Gandhinagar, holes in walls at Malur, and poor rooms at Kamasamudram, where new classrooms are being built.

findings.claim: At a government model higher primary school in Gandhinagar, Kolar, only 3 of 11 rooms were usable, with repairs reportedly overdue for nearly seven years.
findings.quote: There are 11 rooms of which only 3 can be occupied.
findings.title: Karnataka: Fearing for students' lives, parent seeks repair of government school building

findings.claim: A girls' school in Malur town, Kolar district, had only one good room among more than 8 before an NGO-built block was completed in 2020.
findings.quote: The school had multiple buildings with more than 8 rooms, but only one room was is in good condition.
findings.title: Government Model Higher Primary Girls School, Malur, Karnataka

findings.claim: A government school in Kamasamudram, Bangarapet taluk, has 14 rooms, most in poor condition; an NGO began building 8 classrooms in 2025.
findings.quote: The school has 14 rooms in multiple buildings, most of the rooms are in poor condition.
findings.title: Government Model Higher Primary School, Kamasamudram, Karnataka

changes.summary: A 2017 report says Kolar zilla panchayat was the first to reach its 100% toilet target, building 74,854 toilets in a year. No recent usage or coverage data was reachable.

findings.claim: Kolar was reported in 2017 as the first zilla panchayat to hit its full toilet-construction target, with 74,854 toilets built that financial year.
findings.quote: Kolar district is the first zilla panchayat administration to achieve its 100 percent target
findings.title: Karnataka's Kolar district is first to achieve 100% ODF target
